summary: Lego Marvel Super Heroes entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Lego Marvel Super Heroes
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with DLC state documented

emulation.notes: Use console emulators only for port comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC build with exact DLC, unlock, and co-op state documented

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC state documented
primary.why: The PC version is the best capture route for the original Lego Marvel Super Heroes, while handheld/mobile ports are different adaptations. DLC and later console ports should be labeled because roster/content state affects completeness.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC release. Record build, DLC ownership, controller/input, co-op state, graphics settings, story/free-play progress, character unlocks, and whether handheld/mobile or later console ports were compared.

secondary.platform: Nintendo DS / Nintendo 3DS / PlayStation Vita / iOS
secondary.why: They are not fidelity-first substitutes for the PC/console game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Lego Marvel Super Heroes 2 or Lego Marvel's Avengers.
